py() { python3 "$HERE/analysis/$1" "${@:2}"; }

- **Held-out constant row:** `figtab-repo` asked for it in #9. I added it to `make_diag.py` (commit ac99db2) and started `job-b9aa57d864` to regenerate `bias_reference.csv`. It is queued behind other jobs. I'll deliver the file when it ends.
- **Confirmatory block:** `job-ca89fb6b35` (D shard 4) is still running and the host is overloaded (load 54 on 40 CPUs). Until it ends I won't run the freeze or launch the confirmatory block.
- **Not run:** the graph neural network and cluster Horvitz–Thompson estimators. I told the reviewer I'll try a cluster Horvitz–Thompson estimator after P6 and P7 if time allows.
